text_block_list.text: (Chatter… Chatter…)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —— Um… The meeting place should be…

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just a bit further and I'm there. I'm a 
bit late so I'll just run ——

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: …Kyaa!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for helping me. This is 
where I'm supposed to meet up with some 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, the strap on your shoe is broken. 
…It's a little late, but are your plans 
for the day alright?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
They're fine. These shoes are still 
suitable for walking.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Farewell.
Ah, there you are, Messiah. Wait…… Aruvu?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…I see. So that's what happened. That must 
have been a bother to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
…God's sake. Just came here to buy some 
new running shoes. What a chore.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I have nothing to say. Aruvu really helped 
me out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come now, I should pay you back for your 
kindness… What would you like?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
…No thank you, I just happened to be in 
the area.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't say that. Are you free after 
this? How about we go and get a meal ——

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —— I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have something urgent to do, so I'll be 
off. …Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (When… did I get here…?)

text_block_list.name: Mother and Child
text_block_list.text:
— Mommy! Push harder! — Alright, alright. 
Make sure you're holding onto the swing, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …A swing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I've never been… pushed before.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (—— At that time.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (At that time, if only…)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't say that. Are you free after 
this? How about we go and get a meal 
together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …If it's just a meal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alright, it's been decided.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! This… is really delicious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Mm… well, it ain't bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Aruvu, would you like a piece? I can give 
you one on your plate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oi, those strap-on weights look way too 
heavy for her. It ain't good to progress 
the load so much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is this weight more suitable for you? 
…Come now, let's at least try it.
(Drip)

text_block_list.name: Mother and Child
text_block_list.text:
— Mommy! It's raining! — Oh dear! Where's 
the folding umbrella…

On that day, as I arrived in front of the 
train station. I ran into Admire Groove, 
who was walking alone in the rain.
choice_data_list: If you don't have an umbrella, take mine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
…I'm fine. I was just on my way back to 
Tracen.

Even though I called out to her, she 
walked into the rain alone and vanished.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, nothing happened.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …If you'll excuse me.

I tried to reach out to her, but she 
walked into the rain alone and vanished.
